title: Slave Hunting
paragraphs: “Our bodies have gotten a bit sluggish from all this investigating. Plus, Gaelion himself needs to get stronger. The Filolials won’t help with that.”
“Same goes for you, Motoyasu.”
“That’s true. I don’t like the idea of leveling up my rival.”
“Well, since we benefited from others helping us level up, it’s only right that we do the same for someone else. It’ll also serve as good training.”
“Yeah, and right now, I just feel like I need to do something.”
Ren and Itsuki tightened their grips on their weapons.
“I see… Yeah, you’re right.”
“Well, we’ll keep going until we get sleepy. The sun is only starting to set, so let’s go.”
“Are we moving now?”
The assistant asked Father.
“That’s right. We want Windia and the others to get even a little stronger. Sorry for making this decision so suddenly.”
“It’s okay! I’ll do my best!”
“Just don’t get too carried away and put yourself in a situation you can’t recover from.”
“Okay!”
Well, as long as Father is there, things should be fine. Ren and Itsuki are plenty strong, too.
“In the meantime, I’ll go check out various places.”
“We’re counting on you, Motoyasu-san. Strengthening Gaelion is a crucial task for us.”
“Yeah, considering what’s ahead, it’s something we can’t avoid. I’m counting on you.”
“Understood! Yuki-chan, Kou! And Sakura-chan, you’re coming with me!”
“Yes!”
“Then to lure out the Dragon Emperor, Motoyasu-kun should hold onto the remaining core stones.”
“Got it!”

Father handed me the core stones. Since most of them were pretty large, I stored them in a bag. We just need to hunt down the dragons attracted by these stones. I recall my rival complaining about how Ren fights. Like it’s just a game… Well, I personally hate dragons, so I fight them with serious intent to kill, and of course, to gain experience. But this time, it’s not just a game. These dragons are attacking because they want the fragments.
“Come to think of it, when I’m with Naofumi, we seem to run into monsters more often.”
“Maybe they see you as weak, or maybe, judging from Sakura-san and the others’ reactions, monsters are just drawn to you.”
“That’s not something I want to hear… Try being the one who gets attacked all of a sudden…”
“I’ll be going with you, but… am I really not just a burden at this point?”
“It’s fine, it’s fine. Eclair-san, do your best to help protect Windia-chan and Gaelion-chan with me.”
“Alright, then it’s night combat. When should we meet up?”
“Let’s say—”

And so, we set off once again. It feels like we’re moving quickly, which is a good sign. A hero’s duty isn’t just to fight the Waves—it also includes strengthening our forces. That’s exactly what Father was doing in the first world. As for me, I’d like to create a Filolial army.

Where is Filo-tan?! Thanks to the night training, my rival has leveled up to 35. As expected from the strengthened Father, Ren, and Itsuki. With the three of them together, there’s no way they can lose. ---
“Gaogaou!”
My rival, hungry, is devouring the meat of the monsters he defeated. With every bite, he’s gradually growing larger.
“The way creatures that are affected by level growth develop is truly astounding.”
“Humans don’t change even if their level increases, right?”
“Yeah. That said, children who level up during their early years do grow stronger in their own way.”
“That sounds like a recipe for getting drunk on power.”
“I won’t say there aren’t cases like that.”
Father examines my rival while he eats.
“He’s growing at an incredible rate, just like Sakura-chan.”
“Gaogaou!”
“So, Shield Hero… how would you like Gaelion to grow?”
The assistant hesitantly asked Father.
“Hmm… Windia-chan, how do you want to grow?”
“I want to be strong. Like Father.”
“Yeah. Then I guess I feel the same way as Windia-chan.”
Father smiled gently, making the assistant blush slightly.
“Gaou!”
My rival stopped eating and began playfully nuzzling Father. At the same time, Sakura-chan clung to him as well.
“Mmm!”
“Gaou!”
A heated stare-down between Sakura-chan and my rival began.
“Sakura-chan! Do your best!”
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t encourage her!”
“Sakura is cuter!”
Sakura-chan suddenly transformed into her Filolial form, rolling over onto her back in front of Father to show her belly.
“Gaogaou!”
Not to be outdone, my rival did the same.
Hah! To me, that just looks like a pose of submission!
“Yeah, yeah, both of you are cute, so don’t compete over it.”
He gently patted both of their bellies.
“Naofumi-san! Give Sakura-chan more affection!”
“Shield Hero, pamper Gaelion more!”
“Let’s not make unnecessary conflicts, alright?”
Father scolded me along with the assistant.
Tch… Being lumped together with the assistant makes it feel like Filolials and Dragons are being treated as the same, and I don’t like it.
“Hmph! Gaelion could never be like Sakura!”
Sakura-chan transformed into her angelic form and snuggled up to Father.
“Gaogaogao!”
My rival growled in frustration.
Hahaha! This time, Sakura-chan has the upper hand.
“Ahh, geez… Sakura-chan, don’t be so competitive either.”
“But—”
Father scratched his head, looking troubled.
“Just telling them that being born first doesn’t matter probably won’t work, huh…?”
“Umm… Naofumi-san, you kind of sound like a worried parent dealing with their kids.”
“Even if you’re good at looking after others, I guess this kind of issue is unavoidable?”
“Hey, you two, stop watching from the sidelines and help me out. That said, since their species naturally don’t get along, this isn’t something I can fix on my own.”
Saying that, Father limited himself to gently petting both Sakura-chan and my rival to keep them from fighting.

I wonder how Father from the first world handled this issue? That version of him seemed like he had a firm grasp on things, so I’m sure he’ll come up with a solution soon. --- At dawn, we took a short nap before setting out to investigate various matters, also fulfilling Éclair’s request. As usual, I continued slaying dragons, a painful but necessary task to strengthen my rival. That day, too, we spent the night hunting down the Dragon Emperor. ---
“Alright, time to head back!”
I used a portal to teleport to the rendezvous point with Father and the others.
“Ah, welcome back, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Hm?”
There, I saw Father holding an unfamiliar brown creature in his arms. The assistant and my rival looked worried, and even Sakura-chan had forgotten about fighting and seemed uneasy.
“What happened?”
Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair were nowhere to be seen.
“Um… I guess I should start from when Gaelion and the others finished leveling up earlier than expected. Since we had extra time, we decided to investigate the remaining areas for Éclair’s request.”
Father explained that, because he was taking care of the assistants, he moved at a slower pace from the rear.
“In the mountains near the southern border of Melromarc… According to Éclair, it was a secret escape route for demi-humans in case of emergency. We went to check it out just in case, and… well…”

Then, from the direction where Ren and Itsuki had gone ahead, the sound of clashing swords rang out, so Father rushed over. Oh, and apparently, my rival has grown enough to carry the assistant for short distances now. Father, riding Sakura-chan, arrived at the scene to find a group of slave traders. Éclair and the traders were already engaged in some kind of confrontation—or rather, Éclair and her group were the ones who first ran into the slave traders. By the time Father arrived, the slave traders had already been subdued.
